sloka: कृतप्रसादास्तेनैवं राघवेण महात्मना ।जग्मुः स्वं स्वं गृहं सर्वे देही देहमिव त्यजन् ।। ७.४०.२८ ॥
transliteration: kṛtaprasādāstenaivaṁ rāghaveṇa mahātmanā ।jagmuḥ svaṁ svaṁ gṛhaṁ sarve dehī dehamiva tyajan ।। 7.40.28 ॥

translations.english: Having thus received grace from the great-souled Rama, all of them returned to their respective homes, feeling as if an embodied soul abandoning its body.
